description: This file contains command implementations for managing and inspecting background tasks, including listing, showing details, notifying, canceling, auditing, and maintenance operations. It interacts with various task and audit modules, and formats output for terminal display or JSON.

methods.name: truncate
methods.description: Truncates a string to a maximum number of characters, adding an ellipsis if truncated.

methods.name: shortToken
methods.description: Returns a shortened version of a token string, or 'n/a' if undefined or empty.

methods.name: formatTaskStatusCell
methods.description: Formats task status with color themes based on status and whether rich formatting is enabled.

methods.name: formatTaskRows
methods.description: Generates formatted lines representing a list of task records for terminal display.

methods.name: formatTaskListSummary
methods.description: Creates a summary string of task counts by status.

methods.name: formatAgeMs
methods.description: Converts age in milliseconds to a human-readable string.

methods.name: compareSystemAuditFindings
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting audit findings by severity, age, and creation time.

methods.name: formatAuditRows
methods.description: Formats audit findings into display lines for terminal output.

methods.name: toSystemAuditFindings
methods.description: Collects and filters audit findings from task and task flow audits, returning a structured object with summaries.
